about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Alpine Village Subdivision
channels.legal_basis: 401 KAR 5:065 Section 2(5)(a): "If a spill or release of pollutants or contaminants, bypass, upset, or other event of noncompliance occurs that may present an imminent or substantial danger to the environment or the public health or welfare, the permittee shall immediately notify the Division of Water by calling the Division of Water in Frankfort ... or the appropriate regional field office"; (b) the 24-hour environmental emergency telephone number after hours; and the reports of 40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)
channels.note: Alpine Village Subdivision must tell the Division of Water immediately, by telephone only, of a spill, bypass or overflow that may endanger health or the environment (401 KAR 5:065 Section 2(5)); the Division publishes no list. Kentucky's system sent such reports to EPA's overflow tables for December 2025 and January 2026 only: no report under its permits in EPA's tables (2026-11-04 extract). No public notice is required. The permit itself was not read: the standard condition is assumed. (research/ky/report.md §2.1)
